title: Harden CLI option parsing and read-only help paths
description: Reject unknown or missing options consistently for get/show/transitions/comment, support documented flag forms deliberately, and parse help/schema before provider initialization so informational commands do not create or migrate .wtp state. Add exit-code and no-side-effect tests.
